title: Meritocracy and inequality acceptance
title_zh: 精英政治与不平等接受度
abstract: The idea of meritocracy — that income differences should reflect performance rather than luck or inherited privilege — can be used to justify inequality. Yet people who consider meritocracy to be fair may disagree about redistribution. Understanding these disagreements can help to reduce polarization.
abstract_zh: “精英政治”这一理念——即收入差异应反映个人表现而非运气或继承的特权——常被用来为不平等辩护。然而，认为精英政治公平的人可能在再分配问题上存在分歧。了解这些分歧有助于降低社会极化。
